_about: XO Liquor Boulder POS 'variants' export (Item, Barcodes, Units per case, Department, Retail price), supplied by the owner 2026-11-13 (data/reference/variants-xo_liquor_boulder-*.csv, not committed). Barcodes are full codes (12-digit UPC-A 99% check-digit valid; 13-digit EAN). Owner decision 2026-11-13: every stated 'Units per case', including 1, is a real pack size and becomes a review candidate; a value that disagrees with an approved one is reported as a conflict and never overwrites it. Prices and departments are not imported.
